source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: CreateInBackend sets socketType only in the SMTP branch. Current shared Exchange server derives SSL/plain from https/http and rejects a direct SetSocketType call. Its endpoint property is now IExchangeOutgoingServer.exchangeUrl, so the historical nsIEwsServer.initialize(URL) call is stale. Preserve protocol-specific configuration instead of writing every outgoing field through a common branch.
title: Derive Exchange socket type from its endpoint URL
